verdicts.rationale: Clean reproduction confirmed: POST /collections/create with collectionName='_test_collection' succeeded with HTTP 200. However, structured_contract.json contains NO constraints documenting restrictions on collection names starting with underscore. Source code analysis (handler_v2.go:1795-2062) shows createCollection handler performs no naming validation beyond basic schema processing. Without documented constraint prohibiting underscore prefix or reasonable technical justification (databases commonly allow underscore-prefixed names), this cannot be considered a defect. The assertion appears to be based on unstated naming conventions rather than documented contract violation. Matches mundane_api_semantics pattern.
